title: Retro machine pop
summary: Loud, funny, nostalgic computing. It's confident enough to joke ('We raised a really big Series A').
use_when: Launches that need to be remembered, developer communities, products with a strong voice.
avoid_when: Enterprise procurement audiences, or long-form trust content. Only one strong example so far, so treat it as a sketch, not a system.
